# Test Fixtures

All fixtures under this directory are hand-authored from documented provider API shapes (e.g. the published Vapi OpenAPI spec) and sanitized — any ids, org identifiers, phone numbers, URLs, and timestamps are fake placeholders and contain no real credentials, keys, or customer data. They are structured to faithfully match the documented response shapes so mapping and provider code can be tested against realistic payloads, and are intended to be swappable later for real sanitized recordings captured from live API responses.
